important_note: Iron Sucrose does not have any oral pill, tablet, or capsule formulations available in the United States. It is exclusively formulated as an intravenous injection used for iron supplementation in patients with iron-deficiency anemia, particularly those on hemodialysis. The request for pill physical characteristics cannot be fulfilled as no such forms exist in the US market.
